model: INMBSDAI001R000 Daikin VRV / Sky Air to Modbus RTU gateway
applies_to: One Daikin VRV or Sky Air indoor unit (or group) on the P1P2 bus via INMBSDAI001R000, user manual v1.0.1.
summary: Modbus RTU server that connects to the P1P2 remote-controller bus of a Daikin VRV or Sky Air indoor unit. All points are 16-bit holding registers covering on/off, mode, fan, vanes, setpoint, room temperature, alarm and Daikin error code, plus window-contact and virtual-temperature features.

addressing.note: Tables list a 'protocol address' (base 0) and a 'PLC address' (base 1). The protocol address is the wire address and is what 'documented' holds; PLC tools that add 1 should use the PLC column.

source.title: INMBSDAI001R000 Modbus RTU Gateway - Compatible with VRV and Sky air conditioning systems commercialized by Daikin - User Manual
source.pages: printed pp. 6-12 (PDF pp. 9-15); error codes printed p. 16 onward

notes: Every register is documented as a 16-bit unsigned holding register and no temperature range in the manual goes below zero, so temperatures are UINT16. The 'no value' marker the manual writes as -32768 is raw 0x8000 (32768) and is listed as an enum entry. Register 5 prints the marker as -32678, an apparent typo, so no enum is given there.
Temperature scale follows DIP SW4: x1 °C (factory default, stated consistently in this manual), x10 °C or °F (no °F x10). Scale 1 / °C here matches the default only; use 0.1 if x10 is selected.
Baud rate register 14 lists the selectable rates but not the numeric code for each, so no enum is given.
The error-code enum (Daikin remote-controller codes) is not reproduced; see the manual's error code table.

integration.summary: Wire RS-485 A/B, set the address on SW3 and the baud on SW3/SW4, reboot, then read holding registers 0-11 with function 03 and write with function 06. Check SW1: without a Daikin wired remote on the P1P2 bus the gateway must be set as header.
integration.enable: No enable step. Set a slave address on SW3 and keep register 7 (gateway disablement) at 0 so Modbus commands reach the unit.
quirks: Temperature scale changes with DIP SW4 (x1 °C, x10 °C or °F).
Function 16 is accepted only with a quantity of one register.
At most 50 registers per read request.
setup: SW1: header/follower role on the P1P2 bus, VRV operation-mode master/slave, and which sensor is the room reference.
SW3 positions 1-6: slave address (binary). Baud on SW3/SW4 (9600 default).
SW4: temperature scale and 120 Ω termination.
gotchas: Factory SW1 setting is follower, which needs a Daikin wired remote acting as header on P1P2.
Writing an external temperature to register 22 turns on virtual temperature: the wired remote can no longer change the setpoint and register 23 may differ from register 4.
Error code 65535 means the gateway lost the indoor unit.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
